summary: All four repair targets are valid leading-question wording issues and can be repaired by neutralizing the question text.

items.title: 1. Leading confirmation wording
items.rationale: The current q1 question embeds the desired behavior instead of asking for the behavior decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[0].question starts with "Confirm the intended user-visible behavior" and states the exact desired outcome.

items.title: 2. Leading confirmation wording
items.rationale: The current q2 question embeds the desired classification boundary instead of asking what should determine the boundary.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[1].question starts with "Confirm the mechanical classification boundary" and states the exact desired rule.

items.title: 3. Leading confirmation wording
items.rationale: The current q3 question embeds the desired test-review behavior instead of asking what behavior should apply.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question starts with "Confirm test-review behavior" and states the exact desired outcome.

items.title: 4. Leading confirmation wording
items.rationale: The current q4 question embeds the desired acceptance-review responsibility instead of asking what responsibility should apply.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[3].question starts with "Confirm acceptance-review responsibility" and states the exact desired responsibility.
